routeReason: An already validated browser QA issue requires formal Fixer handoff and independent browser retest, although the repair is isolated to one engineering fixture.

diagnosis.cause: The DOM fuel fixture lacks cancelCarPreview, prepareCar, carIsReady and previewCar. Current mobile boot calls cancelCarPreview before loading the stage and preparing the selected model; this aborts fixture initialization and leaves the garage start gate disabled. The fuel-ready label can be rendered before asynchronous native startup is complete.

observations: start requires carIsReady for the equipped car
root.dataset.loaded is set only after native stage identity validation
Preview must return ready with the exact requested carId
Start requires an owned, equipped and displayed model

reproductionMatrix.lifecycle: Initial policy loading and first start
reproductionMatrix.presentation: Current mobile modules with explicit native-game DOM fixture; no GLB renderer
reproductionMatrix.evidence: Original browser run: ready start assertion fails; start action cases wait 10000ms on the disabled garage gate

reproductionMatrix.lifecycle: Double start, background/foreground, ignored native start and storage denial
reproductionMatrix.evidence: All original assertions retained; independent retest pending

changes: Add a starter-only fixture prepare/readiness contract. Unknown models are rejected; fixture responses are explicitly marked fixtureOnly.

Add cancelCarPreview and asynchronous previewCar with matching car identity, menu/loading checks and epoch invalidation. The fixture records the selected preview without constructing or pretending to render a GLB.
The demo fixture invalidates pending previews and records the configured starter identity.

The existing ready helper now requires both the original fuel-policy text and the actual product root.dataset.loaded marker. It never forces the start button enabled and does not increase any timeout.

checks.name: Read-only preservation verification
checks.command: node --input-type=module (read-only SHA-256, test-block, timeout, currentRacingInputHash and buildHash verification)

independentRetest.required: Rerun the ten unchanged original Chromium lifecycle and presentation tests in the existing root browser configuration; retain the failed log and write a separate rerun log. No completion claim until this exact branch passes.

remainingEvidenceGaps: Independent browser retest of the corrected fixture is pending.
These DOM fixture checks do not certify GLB rendering, natural victory, real phones or live SDK behavior.
